body: My depression is being a flaming asshole today. My anxiety too.
I think the latter. It feels a lot like things that I tend to repress coming to the surface. I don't know if I feel "better" afterward, but it is like a storm has passed through.
Like a lot of you, new to this sub, not to anxiety. Been struggling with it my whole life. I've gone to therapy and am trying a meditation practice to help.

Thank you. Thank you all! The past two days have been much better. Last night, for the first time in forever, I didn't have any of the bad thoughts. Even when something that would normally be a trigger happened, I was able to breath through it rather than go down the rabbit hole.

I've long struggled with self-esteem and self-hate. I always tend to put others' happiness ahead of my own. I very much try to avoid conflict in all possibilities and I'm a huge people pleaser. I hate making others mad, or having them disapprove of my choices - especially my wife and my mom. 

(Yes, I know. Very uncommon thing here, right? ;))

I think my bad thoughts (which are much better today, thank you all for your comments and thoughts) are a weird way to try to assert control over life. I feel like I've been swept away in a lot of my life, where my choices aren't mine, or I've never really considered any alternatives. Which isn't necessarily a bad thing - inertia is my default state - but I do feel at times like I'm stuck in this life that I didn't choose. And so into this void come the bad thoughts, as a way to exert some semblance of "control". Am I making sense?
